{
  "name": "measured_joules_to_ACRE_wiring",
  "version": "1.0",
  "flow": [
    "sensor (ΔT, flow, pressure, shaft)",
    "→ local measurement script",
    "→ append to /sdcard/openroot/context_bridge/thermo_ledger.jsonl",
    "→ hive reads ledger",
    "→ ACRE mint claim (only on verified physical work)"
  ],
  "ledger_path": "/sdcard/openroot/context_bridge/thermo_ledger.jsonl",
  "sync_targets": [
    "$OPENROOT_ROOT/context_bridge/thermo_ledger.jsonl",
    "/sdcard/openroot/context_bridge/thermo_ledger.jsonl"
  ],
  "append_only": true,
  "copy_command": "cp /sdcard/openroot/context_bridge/thermo_ledger.jsonl $OPENROOT_ROOT/context_bridge/",
  "status": "live"
}
